hits.title: Neros Closes $75M Series B Fundraise led by Sequoia Capital
hits.snippet: # Neros Closes $75M Series B Fundraise led by Sequoia Capital **El Segundo, CA – November 10, 2025** – Today, Neros has closed its $75M Series B fundraising led by Sequoia Capital with participation from Vy Capital US and Interlagos. This round immediately follows a period of rapid production scaling, significant revenue growth, and successful customer deployments — including a [large drone purchase from the U.S. Marine Corps](https://U.S.%20Marine%20Corps%20preparing%20an%20Archer%20Strike%20FPV%20Drone) and Neros’ selection as one of the primary suppliers of FPV drones to the U.S. Army through the Purpose-Built Attritable System (PBAS) program. This latest capital injection brings Neros’ total raised capital to over $120M and will accelerate expansion of the company’s industrial capacity while strengthening a robust China-free supply chain. Neros will deploy new funding to massively scale the production of its flagship Archer / Archer Strike drone platforms and its Ground Control Systems. It will directly support Neros’ vertically integrated manufacturing approach to insource key steps of the production process while enabling meaningful investments in allied component suppliers.

hits.title: 美国无人机制造商 Neros完成7500万美元B轮融资_低空界_低空经济网_低空行业资讯与产业服务
hits.snippet: # 美国无人机制造商 Neros完成7500万美元B轮融资 近日，美国国防科技初创公司 Neros Technologies 宣布完成了7500万美元的B轮融资。红杉资本领投了 Neros 的 B 轮融资，Vy Capital US 和 Interlagos 也参与了投资，最新一轮融资使其总融资额超过1.2亿美元。本轮资金扩大其旗舰无人机平台Archer和Archer Strike以及地面控制系统的生产规模。该公司称，这笔资金将直接支持Neros的垂直整合制造模式，实现生产流程关键环节的内部化，同时还能投资于相关零部件供应商。 Neros表示，B轮融资是在公司经历了快速扩大生产规模、显著的收入增长以及成功完成客户部署之后进行的。这些部署包括美国海军陆战队的大宗无人机采购，以及公司通过“专用消耗系统”（PBAS）项目被选为美国陆军第一人称视角（FPV）无人机的主要供应商之一。 Neros公司成立于2023年，该公司表示已向乌克兰和美国战争部交付了数千套系统。这家总部位于美国加州埃尔塞贡多的公司自主设计了大部分组件，并专注于提升关键性能，包括抗电子战能力。 Neros的核心产品包括Archer、Archer Strike无人机平台及CROSSBOW、LONGBOW地面控制系统。Archer是一款FPV无人机，专为模块化有效载荷和可靠的通信而设计。Archer Strike是一款动能驱动型FPV，可在对抗环境中远距离造成致命打，专为高性能、合规性和可扩展性而设计。 红杉资本合伙人肖恩·马奎尔指出：“Neros是历史上最快获得重要国防合同的公司之一。这表明FPV无人机对于执行任务至关重要。” Interlagos创始人兼首席执行官Achal Upadhyaya补充道：“无人机性能和高产能密不可分。Neros有望成为美国首个年产百万架无人机的工厂。” Neros首席执行官Soren Monroe-Anderson表示：“我们的B轮融资标志着公司两年多来持续增长、专注产品研发以及基于实战经验不断迭代的成果。这要归功于我们整个团队的不懈努力，正是他们的付出才使我们走到今天。我们衷心感谢投资者们对我们愿景的信任，即重建美国无人机产业基地。” 此外，Neros表示将加大对下一代自主系统架构的研发投入。

hits.snippet: # Neros closes Series B, secures a big contract as drones dominate *As the US Army continues to transform for a war that most hope will never happen, it has started investing in FPVs, which is giving investors the confidence to back companies like Neros.* Neros, a Los Angeles-based manufacturer of First-Person View (FPV) drones, has completed a significant $75 million Series B funding round, underscoring the escalating investment appetite for Western-based defence technology, particularly in the realm of unmanned aerial systems (UAS). The move is a stark indicator of the perceived urgency to establish a secure, “China-free” drone industrial base outside of Asia.
